intro: Pull up the Trento chair and settle in. Soft microfiber, mid back support, and cushioned seating keep you comfy from quick breakfasts to long chats, while knockdown build and easy care fit busy homes.

features.title: Microfiber that feels soft and reliable
features.text: Seat and back in microfiber deliver a smooth, welcoming touch with everyday durability, so spills wipe away easily and your chair keeps looking composed from weekday meals to weekend guests.

features.title: Mid back support that helps you sit tall
features.text: A supportive mid-height back follows your posture, easing shoulders and spine so you feel relaxed and attentive through long conversations, work-from-table sessions, and family dinners.

features.title: 28D foam that cushions every sit
features.text: Seat foam density is tuned for daily comfort, balancing softness and support so you never feel perched or sinky, just comfortably settled across short bites and slow, lingering meals.

features.title: Proportions that free your legs
features.text: The easy-to-live-with footprint lets legs slide in naturally and feet find their place, keeping the area under the table uncluttered and movement light as people come and go.

features.title: Knockdown pair that fits any doorway
features.text: Packed two chairs in one packet and delivered knockdown, it navigates tight corridors and elevators, then assembles sturdy so setup day is smooth even in compact apartments.

features.title: Black legs that ground the look
features.text: A black understructure anchors the soft grey seat and back, giving your dining space a composed contrast that pairs easily with glass, wood, and neutral palettes.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
